title: Claude Managed Agents
content:
## Overview

Claude Managed Agents is a platform-level feature on the Claude API that manages long-running, stateful AI agents for you — handling memory, session continuity, and orchestration without requiring custom infrastructure. Three major capabilities were announced at the **Code with Claude 2026** conference in San Francisco on May 6, 2026: **Dreaming**, **Outcomes**, and **Multiagent Orchestration**.

---

## Dreaming

Dreaming is a scheduled background process that helps agents self-improve between active sessions. Rather than treating each session as isolated, Dreaming reviews past conversation transcripts after they conclude, identifies recurring patterns (repeated errors, frequently needed context, common user goals), and curates the agent's long-term memory stores.

Key properties:
- Runs on a configurable schedule (e.g., nightly) without user involvement
- Never modifies the original session transcripts — only updates the agent's memory layer
- Surfaces patterns and distills them into structured memory entries the agent can retrieve on future runs
- Enables agents to improve through use, similar to how humans learn from experience over time

**Availability:** Research preview as of May 2026; access requires joining a waitlist via a request form.

---

## Outcomes

Outcomes gives developers a structured way to define and track whether an agent successfully achieved its goal. By specifying expected outcomes for a task, you get structured feedback on each agent run — success, partial success, or failure with a reason — without writing your own evaluation harness.

**Availability:** Public beta as of May 2026.

---

## Multiagent Orchestration

Multiagent Orchestration allows a lead (orchestrator) agent to decompose a complex job and delegate parts to up to **20 specialist subagents running in parallel**. Each subagent can have its own:
- Model selection (e.g., Opus for complex reasoning, Haiku for fast classification)
- System prompt and tool set
- Scoped access to a shared filesystem

The orchestrator aggregates results as subagents complete, then produces the final output. This pattern cuts wall-clock time on parallelizable tasks significantly — a code review that previously ran serially across 20 files can run simultaneously.

```
[Orchestrator Agent]
    ├── [Specialist: Code Review] ──> file_a.py
    ├── [Specialist: Code Review] ──> file_b.py
    ├── [Specialist: Security Scan] ──> auth.py
    └── [Specialist: Docs Check] ──> README.md
```

**Availability:** Public beta as of May 2026.

---

## How Managed Agents Differ from the Raw API

| Feature | Raw API | Managed Agents |
|---|---|---|
| Session memory | You manage | Platform-managed |
| Long-term memory | You build | Built-in memory stores |
| Parallel subagents | You orchestrate | Declarative orchestration API |
| Self-improvement | Not available | Dreaming (research preview) |
| Outcome tracking | You implement | Structured Outcomes API |

---

## Getting Started

Managed Agents are available on the Claude Platform. The multiagent orchestration and outcomes features are accessible through the standard API with new request fields; dreaming requires joining the research preview. Documentation is at `platform.claude.com/docs`.
